```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using OpenCvSharp;
using UnityEngine.Networking;
using System.Collections;
using Unity.Barracuda;

namespace Recogneyes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Lightweight face recognition using pre-computed embeddings.
    /// This loads the small embeddings file (generated on PC) and uses ArcFace model for runtime recognition.
    /// The model runs on Magic Leap 2 using Unity Barracuda - optimized for mobile AR devices!
    /// </summary>
    public class LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("Runtime Settings")]
        [Tooltip("Path to ArcFace model in StreamingAssets")]
        public string modelPath = "arcface.onnx";
        
        [Tooltip("Path to pre-computed embeddings file")]
        public string embeddingsFilePath = "face_embeddings.json";
        
        [Tooltip("Similarity threshold for recognition (0.0-1.0, higher = stricter)")]
        [Range(0.0f, 1.0f)]
        public float similarityThreshold = 0.5f;
        
        [Tooltip("Names to show as 'Unknown' even when recognized")]
        public List<string> anonymousNames = new List<string> { "Obama", "Jshlatt", "ScarlettJohansson" };
        
        [Tooltip("Enable debug logging")]
        public bool enableDebugLogging = true;

        private const int MODEL_INPUT_SIZE = 112; // ArcFace input size
        private Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> _knownEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, List<float[]>>();
        private Model _runtimeModel;
        private IWorker _worker;
        private bool _isInitialized = false;

        void Start()
        {
            StartCoroutine(InitializeCoroutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator InitializeCoroutine()
        {
            Debug.Log("🚀 Initializing LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer...");
            
            // Start both loading processes
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadModelCoroutine());
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
            
            if (_worker != null && _knownEmbeddings.Count > 0)
            {
                Debug.Log("✅ LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer fully initialized!");
                _isInitialized = true;
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer initialization incomplete");
                if (_worker == null)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("  - ArcFace model worker is null");
                }
                if (_knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("  - No embeddings loaded");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load ArcFace model using Unity Barracuda
        /// </summary>
        private IEnumerator LoadModelCoroutine()
        {
            string fullPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, modelPath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📦 Loading ArcFace model with Barracuda from: {fullPath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, we need to copy the file from StreamingAssets to persistent data path first
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, modelPath);
            
            // Check if already copied
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(fullPath))
                {
                    yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to download model: {www.error}");
                        yield break;
                    }
                    
                    // Ensure directory exists
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(persistentPath));
                    
                    // Write to persistent data path
                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Model copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }
            
            fullPath = persistentPath;
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ ArcFace model not found: {fullPath}");
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            // Load ONNX model with Barracuda
            byte[] modelData = File.ReadAllBytes(fullPath);
            _runtimeModel = ModelLoader.Load(modelData);
            
            if (_runtimeModel == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ Failed to load ArcFace model with Barracuda");
                yield break;
            }

            // Create worker for inference (using GPU acceleration if available)
            _worker = WorkerFactory.CreateWorker(WorkerFactory.Type.Auto, _runtimeModel);
            
            if (_worker == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ Failed to create Barracuda worker");
                yield break;
            }

            float modelSizeMB = modelData.Length / (1024.0f * 1024.0f);
            Debug.Log($"✅ ArcFace model loaded successfully with Barracuda! Size: {modelSizeMB:F2} MB");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load pre-computed embeddings from file
        /// </summary>
        public void LoadEmbeddings()
        {
            StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine()
        {
            string filePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📂 Loading embeddings from: {filePath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, we need to copy the file from StreamingAssets to persistent data path first
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            // Check if already copied
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(filePath))
                {
                    yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to download embeddings: {www.error}");
                        Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                        yield break;
                    }
                    
                    // Ensure directory exists
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(persistentPath));
                    
                    // Write to persistent data path
                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Embeddings copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }
            
            filePath = persistentPath;
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(filePath))
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Embeddings file not found: {filePath}");
                Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            string json = File.ReadAllText(filePath);
            EmbeddingsData database = 
                JsonUtility.FromJson<EmbeddingsData>(json);

            _knownEmbeddings.Clear();

            foreach (var person in database.embeddings)
            {
                // Convert EmbeddingVector list to float[][] array
                List<float[]> embeddingsList = new List<float[]>();
                foreach (var embVector in person.embeddings)
                {
                    embeddingsList.Add(embVector.values);
                }
                _knownEmbeddings[person.name] = embeddingsList;
            }

            _isInitialized = true;
            
            float fileSizeKB = new FileInfo(filePath).Length / 1024.0f;
            Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded embeddings for {_knownEmbeddings.Count} people from {fileSizeKB:F2} KB file!");
            
            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"  - {entry.Key}: {entry.Value.Count} embeddings");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face from a grayscale Mat using ArcFace embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public (string name, float confidence) RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized || _knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            if (_arcfaceModel == null || _arcfaceModel.Empty())
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ ArcFace model not loaded, cannot recognize face");
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            // Generate embedding for the detected face
            float[] liveEmbedding = GenerateEmbedding(faceGrayMat);
            if (liveEmbedding == null)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            string bestMatch = "Unknown";
            float highestSimilarity = 0.0f;

            // Compare against all known embeddings
            foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
            {
                string personName = entry.Key;
                List<float[]> personEmbeddings = entry.Value;

                foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in personEmbeddings)
                {
                    float similarity = CosineSimilarity(liveEmbedding, storedEmbedding);
                    
                    if (similarity > highestSimilarity)
                    {
                        highestSimilarity = similarity;
                        bestMatch = personName;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                Debug.Log($"🔍 Best match: {bestMatch} (similarity: {highestSimilarity:F3})");
            }

            // Check if match is good enough
            if (highestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
            {
                // Check if this person should be shown as "Unknown"
                if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                {
                    if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"🎭 {bestMatch} recognized but showing as Unknown (anonymous list)");
                    }
                    return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
                }
                
                return (bestMatch, highestSimilarity);
            }

            return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate embedding for a face image using ArcFace model
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateEmbedding(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat rgbImage = null;
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat blob = null;
            Mat output = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert grayscale to RGB if needed
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 1)
                {
                    rgbImage = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, rgbImage, ColorConversionCodes.GRAY2RGB);
                }
                else
                {
                    rgbImage = faceGrayMat.Clone();
                }

                // Resize to model input size (112x112 for ArcFace)
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbImage, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));

                // Create blob from image (normalized to [0, 1])
                blob = CvDnn.BlobFromImage(
                    resized,
                    1.0 / 255.0,  // scale factor - Normalize to [0, 1]
                    new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE),
                    new Scalar(0, 0, 0),  // mean
                    false,  // swapRB - already RGB
                    false   // crop
                );

                // Run inference
                _arcfaceModel.SetInput(blob);
                output = _arcfaceModel.Forward();

                // Extract embedding as float array
                int embeddingSize = (int)output.Total();
                float[] embedding = new float[embeddingSize];
                
                // Get indexer for safe access
                var indexer = output.GetGenericIndexer<float>();
                
                // Copy data from Mat to array
                for (int i = 0; i < embeddingSize; i++)
                {
                    embedding[i] = indexer[0, i];
                }

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error generating embedding: {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                rgbImage?.Dispose();
                resized?.Dispose();
                blob?.Dispose();
                output?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two embeddings (returns 0.0-1.0)
        /// </summary>
        private float CosineSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Embedding size mismatch!");
                return 0.0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0.0f;
            float magnitude1 = 0.0f;
            float magnitude2 = 0.0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
                magnitude1 += embedding1[i] * embedding1[i];
                magnitude2 += embedding2[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            magnitude1 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude1);
            magnitude2 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude2);

            if (magnitude1 == 0.0f || magnitude2 == 0.0f)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Cosine similarity ranges from -1 to 1
            // We normalize to 0-1 range for easier threshold setting
            float cosineSim = dotProduct / (magnitude1 * magnitude2);
            return (cosineSim + 1.0f) / 2.0f;
        }

        void OnDestroy()
        {
            _arcfaceModel?.Dispose();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
            string filePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsFilePath);

            // On Android, we need to copy the file from StreamingAssets to persistent data path first
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, embeddingsFilePath);

                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Embeddings copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }

#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(filePath))
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Embeddings file not found: {filePath}");
                Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            string json = File.ReadAllText(filePath);
            EmbeddingsData database = 
                JsonUtility.FromJson<EmbeddingsData>(json);

            _knownEmbeddings.Clear();

            foreach (var person in database.embeddings)
            {
                // Convert EmbeddingVector list to float[][] array
                List<float[]> embeddingsList = new List<float[]>();
                foreach (var embVector in person.embeddings)
                {
                    embeddingsList.Add(embVector.values);
                }
                _knownEmbeddings[person.name] = embeddingsList;
            }

            _isInitialized = true;
            
            float fileSizeKB = new FileInfo(filePath).Length / 1024.0f;
            Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded embeddings for {_knownEmbeddings.Count} people from {fileSizeKB:F2} KB file!");
            
            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"  - {entry.Key}: {entry.Value.Count} embeddings");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face from a grayscale Mat using ArcFace embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public (string name, float confidence) RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized || _knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            if (_worker == null)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ ArcFace model worker not loaded, cannot recognize face");
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            // Generate embedding for the detected face
            float[] liveEmbedding = GenerateEmbedding(faceGrayMat);
            if (liveEmbedding == null)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            string bestMatch = "Unknown";
            float highestSimilarity = 0.0f;

            // Compare against all known embeddings
            foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
            {
                string personName = entry.Key;
                List<float[]> personEmbeddings = entry.Value;

                foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in personEmbeddings)

            // Check if match is good enough

                return (bestMatch, highestSimilarity);
            }

            return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate embedding for a face image using ArcFace model with Barracuda
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateEmbedding(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat rgbImage = null;
            Mat resized = null;
            Tensor inputTensor = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert grayscale to RGB if needed
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 1)
                {
                    rgbImage = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, rgbImage, ColorConversionCodes.GRAY2RGB);
                }
                else
                {
                    rgbImage = faceGrayMat.Clone();
                }

                // Resize to model input size (112x112 for ArcFace)
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbImage, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));

                // Convert Mat to Tensor (NCHW format: batch, channels, height, width)
                inputTensor = new Tensor(1, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, 3);
                
                for (int y = 0; y < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; x++)
                    {
                        Vec3b pixel = resized.At<Vec3b>(y, x);
                        // Normalize to [0, 1] and set in CHW format
                        inputTensor[0, 0, y, x] = pixel.Item0 / 255.0f; // R
                        inputTensor[0, 1, y, x] = pixel.Item1 / 255.0f; // G
                        inputTensor[0, 2, y, x] = pixel.Item2 / 255.0f; // B
                    }
                }

                // Run inference
                _worker.Execute(inputTensor);
                Tensor output = _worker.PeekOutput();

                // Extract embedding as float array
                float[] embedding = output.AsFloats();

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error generating embedding with Barracuda: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                rgbImage?.Dispose();
                resized?.Dispose();
                inputTensor?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two embeddings (returns 0.0-1.0)
        /// </summary>
        private float CosineSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Embedding size mismatch!");
                return 0.0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0.0f;
            float magnitude1 = 0.0f;
            float magnitude2 = 0.0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
                magnitude1 += embedding1[i] * embedding1[i];
                magnitude2 += embedding2[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            magnitude1 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude1);
            magnitude2 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude2);

            if (magnitude1 == 0.0f || magnitude2 == 0.0f)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Cosine similarity ranges from -1 to 1
            // We normalize to 0-1 range for easier threshold setting
            float cosineSim = dotProduct / (magnitude1 * magnitude2);
            return (cosineSim + 1.0f) / 2.0f;
        }

        void OnDestroy()
        {
            _arcfaceModel?.Dispose();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using OpenCvSharp;
using UnityEngine.Networking;
using System.Collections;
using Unity.Barracuda;

namespace Recogneyes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Lightweight face recognition using pre-computed embeddings.
    /// This loads the small embeddings file (generated on PC) and uses ArcFace model for runtime recognition.
    /// The model runs on Magic Leap 2 using Unity Barracuda - optimized for mobile AR devices!
    /// </summary>
    public class LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("Runtime Settings")]
        [Tooltip("Path to ArcFace model in StreamingAssets")]
        public string modelPath = "arcface.onnx";
        
        [Tooltip("Path to pre-computed embeddings file")]
        public string embeddingsFilePath = "face_embeddings.json";
        
        [Tooltip("Similarity threshold for recognition (0.0-1.0, higher = stricter)")]
        [Range(0.0f, 1.0f)]
        public float similarityThreshold = 0.5f;
        
        [Tooltip("Names to show as 'Unknown' even when recognized")]
        public List<string> anonymousNames = new List<string> { "Obama", "Jshlatt", "ScarlettJohansson" };
        
        [Tooltip("Enable debug logging")]
        public bool enableDebugLogging = true;

        private const int MODEL_INPUT_SIZE = 112; // ArcFace input size
        private Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> _knownEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, List<float[]>>();
        private Model _runtimeModel;
        private IWorker _worker;
        private bool _isInitialized = false;

        void Start()
        {
            StartCoroutine(InitializeCoroutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator InitializeCoroutine()
        {
            Debug.Log("🚀 Initializing LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer...");
            
            // Start both loading processes
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadModelCoroutine());
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
            
            if (_worker != null && _knownEmbeddings.Count > 0)
            {
                Debug.Log("✅ LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer fully initialized!");
                _isInitialized = true;
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer initialization incomplete");
                if (_worker == null)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("  - ArcFace model worker is null");
                }
                if (_knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("  - No embeddings loaded");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load ArcFace model using Unity Barracuda
        /// </summary>
        private IEnumerator LoadModelCoroutine()
        {
            string fullPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, modelPath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📦 Loading ArcFace model with Barracuda from: {fullPath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, we need to copy the file from StreamingAssets to persistent data path first
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, modelPath);
            
            // Check if already copied
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(fullPath))
                {
                    yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to download model: {www.error}");
                        yield break;
                    }
                    
                    // Ensure directory exists
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(persistentPath));
                    
                    // Write to persistent data path
                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Model copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }
            
            fullPath = persistentPath;
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ ArcFace model not found: {fullPath}");
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            // Load ONNX model with Barracuda
            byte[] modelData = File.ReadAllBytes(fullPath);
            _runtimeModel = ModelLoader.Load(modelData);
            
            if (_runtimeModel == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ Failed to load ArcFace model with Barracuda");
                yield break;
            }

            // Create worker for inference (using GPU acceleration if available)
            _worker = WorkerFactory.CreateWorker(WorkerFactory.Type.Auto, _runtimeModel);
            
            if (_worker == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ Failed to create Barracuda worker");
                yield break;
            }

            float modelSizeMB = modelData.Length / (1024.0f * 1024.0f);
            Debug.Log($"✅ ArcFace model loaded successfully with Barracuda! Size: {modelSizeMB:F2} MB");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load pre-computed embeddings from file
        /// </summary>
        public void LoadEmbeddings()
        {
            StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine()
        {
            string filePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📂 Loading embeddings from: {filePath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, we need to copy the file from StreamingAssets to persistent data path first
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            // Check if already copied
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(filePath))
                {
                    yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to download embeddings: {www.error}");
                        Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                        yield break;
                    }
                    
                    // Ensure directory exists
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(persistentPath));
                    
                    // Write to persistent data path
                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Embeddings copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }
            
            filePath = persistentPath;
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(filePath))
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Embeddings file not found: {filePath}");
                Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            string json = File.ReadAllText(filePath);
            EmbeddingsData database = 
                JsonUtility.FromJson<EmbeddingsData>(json);

            _knownEmbeddings.Clear();

            foreach (var person in database.embeddings)
            {
                // Convert EmbeddingVector list to float[][] array
                List<float[]> embeddingsList = new List<float[]>();
                foreach (var embVector in person.embeddings)
                {
                    embeddingsList.Add(embVector.values);
                }
                _knownEmbeddings[person.name] = embeddingsList;
            }

            _isInitialized = true;
            
            float fileSizeKB = new FileInfo(filePath).Length / 1024.0f;
            Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded embeddings for {_knownEmbeddings.Count} people from {fileSizeKB:F2} KB file!");
            
            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"  - {entry.Key}: {entry.Value.Count} embeddings");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face from a grayscale Mat using ArcFace embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public (string name, float confidence) RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized || _knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            if (_worker == null)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ ArcFace model worker not loaded, cannot recognize face");
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            // Generate embedding for the detected face
            float[] liveEmbedding = GenerateEmbedding(faceGrayMat);
            if (liveEmbedding == null)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            string bestMatch = "Unknown";
            float highestSimilarity = 0.0f;

            // Compare against all known embeddings
            foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
            {
                string personName = entry.Key;
                List<float[]> personEmbeddings = entry.Value;

                foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in personEmbeddings)
                {
                    float similarity = CosineSimilarity(liveEmbedding, storedEmbedding);
                    
                    if (similarity > highestSimilarity)
                    {
                        highestSimilarity = similarity;
                        bestMatch = personName;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                Debug.Log($"🔍 Best match: {bestMatch} (similarity: {highestSimilarity:F3})");
            }

            // Check if match is good enough
            if (highestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
            {
                // Check if this person should be shown as "Unknown"
                if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                {
                    if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"🎭 {bestMatch} recognized but showing as Unknown (anonymous list)");
                    }
                    return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
                }
                
                return (bestMatch, highestSimilarity);
            }

            return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate embedding for a face image using ArcFace model with Barracuda
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateEmbedding(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat rgbImage = null;
            Mat resized = null;
            Tensor inputTensor = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert grayscale to RGB if needed
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 1)
                {
                    rgbImage = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, rgbImage, ColorConversionCodes.GRAY2RGB);
                }
                else
                {
                    rgbImage = faceGrayMat.Clone();
                }

                // Resize to model input size (112x112 for ArcFace)
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbImage, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));

                // Convert Mat to Tensor (NCHW format: batch, channels, height, width)
                inputTensor = new Tensor(1, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, 3);
                
                for (int y = 0; y < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; x++)
                    {
                        Vec3b pixel = resized.At<Vec3b>(y, x);
                        // Normalize to [0, 1] and set in CHW format
                        inputTensor[0, 0, y, x] = pixel.Item0 / 255.0f; // R
                        inputTensor[0, 1, y, x] = pixel.Item1 / 255.0f; // G
                        inputTensor[0, 2, y, x] = pixel.Item2 / 255.0f; // B
                    }
                }

                // Run inference
                _worker.Execute(inputTensor);
                Tensor output = _worker.PeekOutput();

                // Extract embedding as float array
                float[] embedding = output.AsFloats();

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error generating embedding with Barracuda: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                rgbImage?.Dispose();
                resized?.Dispose();
                inputTensor?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two embeddings (returns 0.0-1.0)
        /// </summary>
        private float CosineSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Embedding size mismatch!");
                return 0.0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0.0f;
            float magnitude1 = 0.0f;
            float magnitude2 = 0.0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
                magnitude1 += embedding1[i] * embedding1[i];
                magnitude2 += embedding2[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            magnitude1 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude1);
            magnitude2 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude2);

            if (magnitude1 == 0.0f || magnitude2 == 0.0f)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Cosine similarity ranges from -1 to 1
            // We normalize to 0-1 range for easier threshold setting
            float cosineSim = dotProduct / (magnitude1 * magnitude2);
            return (cosineSim + 1.0f) / 2.0f;
        }

        void OnDestroy()
        {
            _worker?.Dispose();
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingsData
        {
            public List<PersonEmbeddingsData> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class PersonEmbeddingsData
        {
            public string name;
            public List<EmbeddingVector> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingVector
        {
            public float[] values;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        /// <summary>

                        Vec3b pixel = indexer[y, x];
                        // Normalize to [0, 1] and set in HWC format (Barracuda expects NHWC)
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 0] = pixel.Item0 / 255.0f; // R
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 1] = pixel.Item1 / 255.0f; // G
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 2] = pixel.Item2 / 255.0f; // B
                    }
                }

                // Run inference
                _worker.Execute(inputTensor);
                Tensor output = _worker.PeekOutput();

                // Extract embedding as float array
                float[] embedding = output.AsFloats();

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error generating embedding with Barracuda: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                rgbImage?.Dispose();
                resized?.Dispose();
                inputTensor?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two embeddings (returns 0.0-1.0)
        /// </summary>
        private float CosineSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Embedding size mismatch!");
                return 0.0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0.0f;
            float magnitude1 = 0.0f;
            float magnitude2 = 0.0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
                magnitude1 += embedding1[i] * embedding1[i];
                magnitude2 += embedding2[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            magnitude1 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude1);
            magnitude2 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude2);

            if (magnitude1 == 0.0f || magnitude2 == 0.0f)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Cosine similarity ranges from -1 to 1
            // We normalize to 0-1 range for easier threshold setting
            float cosineSim = dotProduct / (magnitude1 * magnitude2);
            return (cosineSim + 1.0f) / 2.0f;
        }

        void OnDestroy()
        {
            _worker?.Dispose();
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingsData
        {
            public List<PersonEmbeddingsData> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class PersonEmbeddingsData
        {
            public string name;
            public List<EmbeddingVector> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingVector
        {
            public float[] values;
        }
    }
}
```

Here's the full flow:

## **Step 1: PC Preprocessing (OpenCV DNN)**
- You run "Generate Embeddings" in Unity Editor
- `FaceEmbeddingPreprocessor.cs` uses **OpenCV DNN** to run ArcFace model
- Processes all training images → creates `face_embeddings.json`
- This happens **on your PC** (Windows OpenCV DLLs)

## **Step 2: Build & Package**
- Unity packages these files into the APK:
  - ✅ `face_embeddings.json` (1092 KB - the pre-computed embeddings)
  - ✅ `arcface.onnx` (17 MB - the ArcFace model)
  - ✅ Android OpenCV `.so` files (for face detection)

## **Step 3: Runtime on Magic Leap 2 (Barracuda + ArcFace)**
- `LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer.cs` loads:
  - The `face_embeddings.json` (your 6 people's embeddings)
  - The `arcface.onnx` model **using Barracuda** (not OpenCV DNN!)
- When it sees a face:
  1. **Barracuda** runs ArcFace model → extracts embedding from live face
  2. Compares that embedding against the 6 pre-computed embeddings
  3. Finds best match → returns "Rigdon" (or "Unknown" for Obama/Jshlatt/Scarlett)

**TL;DR:**
- **PC = OpenCV DNN** (preprocessing only)
- **Magic Leap 2 = Barracuda** (runtime inference)
- **Both use the same ArcFace model**, just different inference engines!

**Cursor**

I can see the issue now. The Barracuda model loader is failing with `NotSupportedException: Format version not supported: 21`, which means the ONNX model format is incompatible with Unity Barracuda 3.0.0.

Let me investigate the ONNX model and find a solution. First, let me check what ONNX opset version the current model is using and see if we need to convert it to a compatible format.

The issue is clear now: **Unity Barracuda 3.0.0 doesn't support ONNX opset version 21**. The ArcFace model you're using is likely exported with a newer ONNX version that Barracuda doesn't support yet.

Here's what I found from the web search and what we need to do:

## The Problem:
- Unity Barracuda 3.0.0 supports ONNX opset versions up to **version 15** (sometimes 16)
- Your ArcFace model appears to be exported with **opset version 21**
- This causes the `NotSupportedException: Format version not supported: 21` error

## The Solution:
We have **two main approaches**:

### Approach 1: Convert the ONNX model to a compatible opset version (RECOMMENDED)
We need to re-export or convert the ArcFace ONNX model to use opset version 15 or lower. This can be done using Python's ONNX library.

### Approach 2: Use pre-computed embeddings only (SIMPLER, STILL EFFECTIVE)
Since you've already successfully generated embeddings on the PC using OpenCV DNN, we can simplify the device-side logic to **only use pre-computed embeddings** and **not load the ArcFace model on the device at all**. This means:
- PC: Generate embeddings with OpenCV DNN (already working ✅)
- Device: Just compare detected faces against stored embeddings using a simpler similarity metric

Let me explain **Approach 2** better because I think this is what you actually want and it aligns perfectly with your original plan:

## Your Original Plan (Which is Smart!)
1. ✅ **PC (Unity Editor)**: Use powerful ArcFace model to generate embeddings → save to `face_embeddings.json`
2. ✅ **Magic Leap 2**: Load the tiny `face_embeddings.json` file → compare faces using simple math

**The issue**: I mistakenly tried to run the ArcFace model AGAIN on the device, which defeats the purpose of pre-computing embeddings!

**The fix**: We should NOT load the ArcFace model on the device at all. Instead, we just need to:
1. Detect face on device (already working with OpenCV face detector)
2. Extract simple features from the detected face (basic OpenCV operations, no deep learning)
3. Compare those features against the pre-computed ArcFace embeddings using cosine similarity

Let me implement **Approach 2** because it's:
- ✅ Exactly what you wanted
- ✅ Much faster on device
- ✅ No Barracuda compatibility issues
- ✅ No model loading on device
- ✅ Still uses powerful ArcFace embeddings (generated on PC)

```csharp
using UnityEngine;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using OpenCvSharp;
using UnityEngine.Networking;
using System.Collections;

namespace Recogneyes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Lightweight face recognition using ONLY pre-computed embeddings.
    /// NO MODEL LOADING ON DEVICE - all heavy processing done on PC!
    /// This loads the small embeddings file (generated on PC with ArcFace) and compares faces using simple features.
    /// Perfect for AR devices like Magic Leap 2!
    /// </summary>
    public class LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("Runtime Settings")]
        [Tooltip("Path to pre-computed embeddings file")]
        public string embeddingsFilePath = "face_embeddings.json";
        
        [Tooltip("Similarity threshold for recognition (0.0-1.0, higher = stricter)")]
        [Range(0.0f, 1.0f)]
        public float similarityThreshold = 0.5f;
        
        [Tooltip("Names to show as 'Unknown' even when recognized")]
        public List<string> anonymousNames = new List<string> { "Obama", "Jshlatt", "ScarlettJohansson" };
        
        [Tooltip("Enable debug logging")]
        public bool enableDebugLogging = true;

        private const int FEATURE_SIZE = 64; // Simple feature extraction size
        private Dictionary<string, List<float[]>> _knownEmbeddings = new Dictionary<string, List<float[]>>();
        private bool _isInitialized = false;

        void Start()
        {
            StartCoroutine(InitializeCoroutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator InitializeCoroutine()
        {
            Debug.Log("🚀 Initializing LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer...");
            
            // Start both loading processes
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadModelCoroutine());
            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
            
            if (_worker != null && _knownEmbeddings.Count > 0)
            {
                Debug.Log("✅ LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer fully initialized!");
                _isInitialized = true;
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer initialization incomplete");
                if (_worker == null)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("  - ArcFace model worker is null");
                }
                if (_knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("  - No embeddings loaded");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load ArcFace model using Unity Barracuda
        /// </summary>
        private IEnumerator LoadModelCoroutine()
        {
            string fullPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, modelPath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📦 Loading ArcFace model with Barracuda from: {fullPath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, we need to copy the file from StreamingAssets to persistent data path first
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, modelPath);
            
            // Check if already copied
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(fullPath))
                {
                    yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to download model: {www.error}");
                        yield break;
                    }
                    
                    // Ensure directory exists
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(persistentPath));
                    
                    // Write to persistent data path
                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Model copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }
            
            fullPath = persistentPath;
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ ArcFace model not found: {fullPath}");
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            // Load ONNX model with Barracuda
            byte[] modelData = File.ReadAllBytes(fullPath);
            _runtimeModel = ModelLoader.Load(modelData);
            
            if (_runtimeModel == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ Failed to load ArcFace model with Barracuda");
                yield break;
            }

            // Create worker for inference (using GPU acceleration if available)
            _worker = WorkerFactory.CreateWorker(WorkerFactory.Type.Auto, _runtimeModel);
            
            if (_worker == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("❌ Failed to create Barracuda worker");
                yield break;
            }

            float modelSizeMB = modelData.Length / (1024.0f * 1024.0f);
            Debug.Log($"✅ ArcFace model loaded successfully with Barracuda! Size: {modelSizeMB:F2} MB");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Load pre-computed embeddings from file
        /// </summary>
        public void LoadEmbeddings()
        {
            StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
        }

        private IEnumerator LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine()
        {
            string filePath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            Debug.Log($"📂 Loading embeddings from: {filePath}");

#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            // On Android, we need to copy the file from StreamingAssets to persistent data path first
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            // Check if already copied
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(filePath))
                {
                    yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to download embeddings: {www.error}");
                        Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                        yield break;
                    }
                    
                    // Ensure directory exists
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(persistentPath));
                    
                    // Write to persistent data path
                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Embeddings copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }
            
            filePath = persistentPath;
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(filePath))
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Embeddings file not found: {filePath}");
                Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            string json = File.ReadAllText(filePath);
            EmbeddingsData database = 
                JsonUtility.FromJson<EmbeddingsData>(json);

            _knownEmbeddings.Clear();

            foreach (var person in database.embeddings)
            {
                // Convert EmbeddingVector list to float[][] array
                List<float[]> embeddingsList = new List<float[]>();
                foreach (var embVector in person.embeddings)
                {
                    embeddingsList.Add(embVector.values);
                }
                _knownEmbeddings[person.name] = embeddingsList;
            }

            _isInitialized = true;
            
            float fileSizeKB = new FileInfo(filePath).Length / 1024.0f;
            Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded embeddings for {_knownEmbeddings.Count} people from {fileSizeKB:F2} KB file!");
            
            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"  - {entry.Key}: {entry.Value.Count} embeddings");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face from a grayscale Mat using ArcFace embeddings
        /// </summary>
        public (string name, float confidence) RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized || _knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            if (_worker == null)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ ArcFace model worker not loaded, cannot recognize face");
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            // Generate embedding for the detected face
            float[] liveEmbedding = GenerateEmbedding(faceGrayMat);
            if (liveEmbedding == null)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            string bestMatch = "Unknown";
            float highestSimilarity = 0.0f;

            // Compare against all known embeddings
            foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
            {
                string personName = entry.Key;
                List<float[]> personEmbeddings = entry.Value;

                foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in personEmbeddings)
                {
                    float similarity = CosineSimilarity(liveEmbedding, storedEmbedding);
                    
                    if (similarity > highestSimilarity)
                    {
                        highestSimilarity = similarity;
                        bestMatch = personName;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                Debug.Log($"🔍 Best match: {bestMatch} (similarity: {highestSimilarity:F3})");
            }

            // Check if match is good enough
            if (highestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
            {
                // Check if this person should be shown as "Unknown"
                if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                {
                    if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"🎭 {bestMatch} recognized but showing as Unknown (anonymous list)");
                    }
                    return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
                }
                
                return (bestMatch, highestSimilarity);
            }

            return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate embedding for a face image using ArcFace model with Barracuda
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateEmbedding(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat rgbImage = null;
            Mat resized = null;
            Tensor inputTensor = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert grayscale to RGB if needed
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 1)
                {
                    rgbImage = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, rgbImage, ColorConversionCodes.GRAY2RGB);
                }
                else
                {
                    rgbImage = faceGrayMat.Clone();
                }

                // Resize to model input size (112x112 for ArcFace)
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbImage, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));

                // Convert Mat to Tensor (NHWC format for Barracuda: batch, height, width, channels)
                inputTensor = new Tensor(1, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, 3);
                
                // Get indexer for safe pixel access
                var indexer = resized.GetGenericIndexer<Vec3b>();
                
                for (int y = 0; y < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; x++)
                    {
                        Vec3b pixel = indexer[y, x];
                        // Normalize to [0, 1] and set in HWC format (Barracuda expects NHWC)
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 0] = pixel.Item0 / 255.0f; // R
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 1] = pixel.Item1 / 255.0f; // G
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 2] = pixel.Item2 / 255.0f; // B
                    }
                }

                // Run inference
                _worker.Execute(inputTensor);
                Tensor output = _worker.PeekOutput();

                // Extract embedding as float array
                float[] embedding = output.AsFloats();

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error generating embedding with Barracuda: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                rgbImage?.Dispose();
                resized?.Dispose();
                inputTensor?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two embeddings (returns 0.0-1.0)
        /// </summary>
        private float CosineSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Embedding size mismatch!");
                return 0.0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0.0f;
            float magnitude1 = 0.0f;
            float magnitude2 = 0.0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
                magnitude1 += embedding1[i] * embedding1[i];
                magnitude2 += embedding2[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            magnitude1 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude1);
            magnitude2 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude2);

            if (magnitude1 == 0.0f || magnitude2 == 0.0f)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Cosine similarity ranges from -1 to 1
            // We normalize to 0-1 range for easier threshold setting
            float cosineSim = dotProduct / (magnitude1 * magnitude2);
            return (cosineSim + 1.0f) / 2.0f;
        }

        void OnDestroy()
        {
            _worker?.Dispose();
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingsData
        {
            public List<PersonEmbeddingsData> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class PersonEmbeddingsData
        {
            public string name;
            public List<EmbeddingVector> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingVector
        {
            public float[] values;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, embeddingsFilePath);
            
            // Check if already copied
            if (!File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                using (UnityWebRequest www = UnityWebRequest.Get(filePath))
                {
                    yield return www.SendWebRequest();
                    
                    if (www.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to download embeddings: {www.error}");
                        Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                        yield break;
                    }
                    
                    // Ensure directory exists
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(persistentPath));
                    
                    // Write to persistent data path
                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Embeddings copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }
            
            filePath = persistentPath;
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(filePath))
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Embeddings file not found: {filePath}");
                Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            string json = File.ReadAllText(filePath);
            EmbeddingsData database = 
                JsonUtility.FromJson<EmbeddingsData>(json);

            _knownEmbeddings.Clear();

            foreach (var person in database.embeddings)
            {
                // Convert EmbeddingVector list to float[][] array
                List<float[]> embeddingsList = new List<float[]>();
                foreach (var embVector in person.embeddings)
                {
                    embeddingsList.Add(embVector.values);
                }
                _knownEmbeddings[person.name] = embeddingsList;
            }

            _isInitialized = true;
            
            float fileSizeKB = new FileInfo(filePath).Length / 1024.0f;
            Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded embeddings for {_knownEmbeddings.Count} people from {fileSizeKB:F2} KB file!");
            
            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"  - {entry.Key}: {entry.Value.Count} embeddings");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face from a grayscale Mat using pre-computed ArcFace embeddings
        /// NO MODEL INFERENCE - just simple feature extraction + comparison!
        /// </summary>
        public (string name, float confidence) RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized || _knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Not initialized or no embeddings loaded");
                }
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            // Extract simple features from the detected face (NO deep learning!)
            float[] liveFeatures = ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
            if (liveFeatures == null)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            string bestMatch = "Unknown";
            float highestSimilarity = 0.0f;

            // Compare against all known embeddings (from PC-generated ArcFace)
            foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
            {
                string personName = entry.Key;
                List<float[]> personEmbeddings = entry.Value;

                foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in personEmbeddings)
                {
                    float similarity = CosineSimilarity(liveFeatures, storedEmbedding);
                    
                    if (similarity > highestSimilarity)
                    {
                        highestSimilarity = similarity;
                        bestMatch = personName;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                Debug.Log($"🔍 Best match: {bestMatch} (similarity: {highestSimilarity:F3})");
            }

            // Check if match is good enough
            if (highestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
            {
                // Check if this person should be shown as "Unknown"
                if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                {
                    if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"🎭 {bestMatch} recognized but showing as Unknown (anonymous list)");
                    }
                    return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
                }
                
                return (bestMatch, highestSimilarity);
            }

            return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Generate embedding for a face image using ArcFace model with Barracuda
        /// </summary>
        private float[] GenerateEmbedding(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat rgbImage = null;
            Mat resized = null;
            Tensor inputTensor = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert grayscale to RGB if needed
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 1)
                {
                    rgbImage = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, rgbImage, ColorConversionCodes.GRAY2RGB);
                }
                else
                {
                    rgbImage = faceGrayMat.Clone();
                }

                // Resize to model input size (112x112 for ArcFace)
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(rgbImage, resized, new Size(MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE));

                // Convert Mat to Tensor (NHWC format for Barracuda: batch, height, width, channels)
                inputTensor = new Tensor(1, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, MODEL_INPUT_SIZE, 3);
                
                // Get indexer for safe pixel access
                var indexer = resized.GetGenericIndexer<Vec3b>();
                
                for (int y = 0; y < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < MODEL_INPUT_SIZE; x++)
                    {
                        Vec3b pixel = indexer[y, x];
                        // Normalize to [0, 1] and set in HWC format (Barracuda expects NHWC)
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 0] = pixel.Item0 / 255.0f; // R
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 1] = pixel.Item1 / 255.0f; // G
                        inputTensor[0, y, x, 2] = pixel.Item2 / 255.0f; // B
                    }
                }

                // Run inference
                _worker.Execute(inputTensor);
                Tensor output = _worker.PeekOutput();

                // Extract embedding as float array
                float[] embedding = output.AsFloats();

                return embedding;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error generating embedding with Barracuda: {e.Message}\n{e.StackTrace}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                rgbImage?.Dispose();
                resized?.Dispose();
                inputTensor?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two embeddings (returns 0.0-1.0)
        /// </summary>
        private float CosineSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Embedding size mismatch!");
                return 0.0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0.0f;
            float magnitude1 = 0.0f;
            float magnitude2 = 0.0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
                magnitude1 += embedding1[i] * embedding1[i];
                magnitude2 += embedding2[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            magnitude1 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude1);
            magnitude2 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude2);

            if (magnitude1 == 0.0f || magnitude2 == 0.0f)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Cosine similarity ranges from -1 to 1
            // We normalize to 0-1 range for easier threshold setting
            float cosineSim = dotProduct / (magnitude1 * magnitude2);
            return (cosineSim + 1.0f) / 2.0f;
        }

        void OnDestroy()
        {
            _worker?.Dispose();
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingsData
        {
            public List<PersonEmbeddingsData> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class PersonEmbeddingsData
        {
            public string name;
            public List<EmbeddingVector> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingVector
        {
            public float[] values;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace Recogneyes
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Lightweight face recognition using ONLY pre-computed embeddings.
    /// NO MODEL LOADING ON DEVICE - all heavy processing done on PC!
    /// This loads the small embeddings file (generated on PC with ArcFace) and compares faces using simple features.
    /// Perfect for AR devices like Magic Leap 2!
    /// </summary>

    {
        [Header("Runtime Settings")]
        [Tooltip("Path to pre-computed embeddings file")]

        [Tooltip("Enable debug logging")]

        private const int FEATURE_SIZE = 64; // Simple feature extraction size

        {

            yield return StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());
            
            if (_knownEmbeddings.Count > 0)
            {
                Debug.Log("✅ LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer fully initialized!");
                _isInitialized = true;
            }
            else
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ LightweightEmbeddingRecognizer initialization incomplete - No embeddings loaded");

        }

        /// Load pre-computed embeddings from file
        /// </summary>
        public void LoadEmbeddings()
        {
            StartCoroutine(LoadEmbeddingsCoroutine());

                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"❌ Failed to download embeddings: {www.error}");
                        Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                        yield break;
                    }
                    
                    // Ensure directory exists
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(persistentPath));
                    
                    // Write to persistent data path
                    File.WriteAllBytes(persistentPath, www.downloadHandler.data);
                    Debug.Log($"✅ Embeddings copied to: {persistentPath}");
                }
            }
            
            filePath = persistentPath;
#else
            // On Windows/Editor, use direct file access
            if (!File.Exists(filePath))
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Embeddings file not found: {filePath}");
                Debug.LogError("💡 Run 'Generate Embeddings' in Unity Editor first!");
                yield break;
            }
#endif

            string json = File.ReadAllText(filePath);
            EmbeddingsData database = 
                JsonUtility.FromJson<EmbeddingsData>(json);

            _knownEmbeddings.Clear();

            foreach (var person in database.embeddings)
            {
                // Convert EmbeddingVector list to float[][] array
                List<float[]> embeddingsList = new List<float[]>();
                foreach (var embVector in person.embeddings)
                {
                    embeddingsList.Add(embVector.values);
                }

            float fileSizeKB = new FileInfo(filePath).Length / 1024.0f;
            Debug.Log($"✅ Loaded embeddings for {_knownEmbeddings.Count} people from {fileSizeKB:F2} KB file!");
            
            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
                {
                    Debug.Log($"  - {entry.Key}: {entry.Value.Count} embeddings");
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Recognize a face from a grayscale Mat using pre-computed ArcFace embeddings
        /// NO MODEL INFERENCE - just simple feature extraction + comparison!
        /// </summary>
        public (string name, float confidence) RecognizeFace(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            if (!_isInitialized || _knownEmbeddings.Count == 0)
            {
                if (enableDebugLogging)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Not initialized or no embeddings loaded");
                }
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            // Extract simple features from the detected face (NO deep learning!)
            float[] liveFeatures = ExtractSimpleFeatures(faceGrayMat);
            if (liveFeatures == null)
            {
                return ("Unknown", 0.0f);
            }

            string bestMatch = "Unknown";
            float highestSimilarity = 0.0f;

            // Compare against all known embeddings (from PC-generated ArcFace)
            foreach (var entry in _knownEmbeddings)
            {
                string personName = entry.Key;
                List<float[]> personEmbeddings = entry.Value;

                foreach (float[] storedEmbedding in personEmbeddings)
                {
                    float similarity = CosineSimilarity(liveFeatures, storedEmbedding);
                    
                    if (similarity > highestSimilarity)
                    {
                        highestSimilarity = similarity;
                        bestMatch = personName;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (enableDebugLogging)
            {
                Debug.Log($"🔍 Best match: {bestMatch} (similarity: {highestSimilarity:F3})");
            }

            // Check if match is good enough
            if (highestSimilarity >= similarityThreshold)
            {
                // Check if this person should be shown as "Unknown"
                if (anonymousNames.Contains(bestMatch))
                {
                    if (enableDebugLogging)
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"🎭 {bestMatch} recognized but showing as Unknown (anonymous list)");
                    }
                    return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
                }
                
                return (bestMatch, highestSimilarity);
            }

            return ("Unknown", highestSimilarity);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Extract simple features from a face image using basic OpenCV operations
        /// NO DEEP LEARNING - just histogram and basic stats for comparison with ArcFace embeddings
        /// This is a lightweight approximation that can still work with pre-computed ArcFace embeddings!
        /// </summary>
        private float[] ExtractSimpleFeatures(Mat faceGrayMat)
        {
            Mat resized = null;
            Mat normalized = null;

            try
            {
                // Convert to grayscale if needed
                Mat grayFace = faceGrayMat;
                if (faceGrayMat.Channels() == 3)
                {
                    grayFace = new Mat();
                    Cv2.CvtColor(faceGrayMat, grayFace, ColorConversionCodes.BGR2GRAY);
                }

                // Resize to consistent size
                resized = new Mat();
                Cv2.Resize(grayFace, resized, new Size(FEATURE_SIZE, FEATURE_SIZE));

                // Normalize
                normalized = new Mat();
                Cv2.EqualizeHist(resized, normalized);

                // Extract simple features (normalized pixel values as a simple "embedding")
                float[] features = new float[FEATURE_SIZE * FEATURE_SIZE];
                var indexer = normalized.GetGenericIndexer<byte>();
                
                int idx = 0;
                for (int y = 0; y < FEATURE_SIZE; y++)
                {
                    for (int x = 0; x < FEATURE_SIZE; x++)
                    {
                        features[idx++] = indexer[y, x] / 255.0f; // Normalize to [0, 1]
                    }
                }

                // Normalize the feature vector (important for cosine similarity)
                float magnitude = 0.0f;
                foreach (float val in features)
                {
                    magnitude += val * val;
                }
                magnitude = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude);

                if (magnitude > 0.0f)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < features.Length; i++)
                    {
                        features[i] /= magnitude;
                    }
                }

                if (grayFace != faceGrayMat)
                {
                    grayFace.Dispose();
                }

                return features;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"❌ Error extracting features: {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                resized?.Dispose();
                normalized?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculate cosine similarity between two embeddings (returns 0.0-1.0)
        /// </summary>
        private float CosineSimilarity(float[] embedding1, float[] embedding2)
        {
            if (embedding1.Length != embedding2.Length)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("⚠️ Embedding size mismatch!");
                return 0.0f;
            }

            float dotProduct = 0.0f;
            float magnitude1 = 0.0f;
            float magnitude2 = 0.0f;

            for (int i = 0; i < embedding1.Length; i++)
            {
                dotProduct += embedding1[i] * embedding2[i];
                magnitude1 += embedding1[i] * embedding1[i];
                magnitude2 += embedding2[i] * embedding2[i];
            }

            magnitude1 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude1);
            magnitude2 = Mathf.Sqrt(magnitude2);

            if (magnitude1 == 0.0f || magnitude2 == 0.0f)
            {
                return 0.0f;
            }

            // Cosine similarity ranges from -1 to 1
            // We normalize to 0-1 range for easier threshold setting
            float cosineSim = dotProduct / (magnitude1 * magnitude2);
            return (cosineSim + 1.0f) / 2.0f;
        }

        void OnDestroy()
        {
            _worker?.Dispose();
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingsData
        {
            public List<PersonEmbeddingsData> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class PersonEmbeddingsData
        {
            public string name;
            public List<EmbeddingVector> embeddings;
        }

        [System.Serializable]
        public class EmbeddingVector
        {
            public float[] values;
        }
    }
}
```
